_doc: Performance budgets (Step 41). sim: tools/bench/sim_bench.gd --size N --hours H --offline 8 --check -- the result hash of StressIsland after H simulated hours must stay exactly this (the code may only get faster, never play differently), wall ms per simulated hour and the 8-hour offline catch-up's wall seconds stay under budget (desktop, headless; a busy machine needs the headroom). The hash changes only when the rules do: Step 42 rebalanced the data (780062055 -> 174450136). Before Step 41 the 30x30 island took 42,527 ms per simulated hour and its capped catch-up 127.9 s. render: tools/bench/render_bench.gd --check, run with godot --fixed-fps 60 -- per second on the large demo island, counts not times (the same on any machine): building rings redrawn, Momo bodies redrawn, buildings and Momo animating, nodes running per-frame code. Before Step 41: 11,520 rings and 3,840 Momo bodies a second, all 347 nodes always processing.
